caption: The drawing depicts a full-body statue of a woman standing on a rectangular, weathered pedestal. The figure is dressed in a colorful, theatrical costume consisting of a red fitted bodice with gold trim and green accents, and a short, white apron or skirt that has a light purple hue and green edging. She wears brown stockings and matching shoes that appear to be heeled. The woman has fair skin and long, dark hair flowing behind her, partially covered by a hat or turban that has alternating light blue and red bands, adorned with a prominent decorative element in front. One arm is bent at the elbow, with her hand touching her chest near the neckline, while the other hand holds a set of objects that resemble cigars or small sticks. A green scarf or sash hangs down at her sides. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the figure and her attire.
title: Cigar Store Figure
